commits_data.title: dect_nr: Add CVG reassembly
commits_data.message:
dect_nr: Add CVG reassembly

Implement CVG reassembly similar to DLC reassembly.
Improve layout of the protocol tree entries (MAC, DLC, CVG).
The CVG header length is IE payload length, not IE length.
